title: Liquidity Support in Financial Institutions
authors: Falko Fecht; Egemen Genç; Yigitcan Karabulut; Patrick Weber
eligible_reason: Not a staggered binary DiD. Main-text Tables 2-13 (src/03_outputs/11_tables_maintext.do) are flow-on-flow regressions of German bank-affiliated mutual funds: reghdfe nbank_flow_agg_navw1 Lnbank_flow_agg_navw1 Lnoutside_flow_navw1 c.noutside_flow_navw1##1.distress $fund_controls, with family, quarter, family x quarter or fund x year FE. The coefficient of interest is the interaction of a continuous regressor (outside flows) with a distress indicator, and every column includes the lagged outcome and time-varying fund controls. Table 4 adds a switcher (affiliation-change) triple interaction; other tables add cross-sectional splits, security-level holdings changes, credit-line and alpha regressions on continuous measures. The only treated x Post design (Online Appendix Table OA1, affiliation switches) is a quadruple interaction with continuous flows, controls and lagged flows, and appendix-only.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe; master.do runs src/01_data_construction then src/03_outputs/11_tables_maintext.do (main text), 13b_table14_opportunity_cost.do and 12_tables_online_appendix.do. Fund-quarter panel built from confidential Bundesbank IFS-B, SHS-BP, CSDB, BISTA and credit-register data plus licensed Datastream; affiliation mapping (Matching Liste.xlsx) held in the Bundesbank FDSZ environment. Clustering fund and quarter.
data_files_note: replication_package/data/PLACEHOLDERS/README_DATA_NOT_INCLUDED.txt and README.tex: confidential Bundesbank microdata and licensed third-party inputs are not included; access only via the Bundesbank RDSC/FDSZ secure environment.
screener_notes: Screened from package code, README and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). No staggered binary treatment; continuous flow interactions with lagged outcomes and controls throughout; data not shipped.
